message.body:
New assigned task 86: Mail sending-domain authentication domain guard

Execute exactly one verified ChangeSet: cs-mail-sending-domain-authentication-domain-guard-fd001-alignment.

Source/result chain: task82 completed/promoted outbound DKIM signing guard at commit 5ea9cff19a234345d9ce7c8a154e8c09a734ba63 after outbound reputation/DLP/tracker/workflow guards. Continue IP-007/P04 outbound SMTP risk-first domain work: no production-active sending domain may send unless tenant/domain authentication posture is complete and current (SPF present, DMARC policy configured, DKIM selector/key rotation within policy, domain verified for this tenant) before SMTP delivery paths can treat it as production-active.

Authoritative refs to load before editing: specs/root-hub-pointers.json, docs/AGENTS.md, specs/masterplan.json, specs/master-plan-sequencing.json, .omc/plans/milestones/M07-first-tenant/phases/P04-connect-pro-mail/{phase-spec.md,impl-plan.md}, docs/prds/connect.md AC-01/SMTP deliverability, specs/microservices/mail.json rules around DMARC policy before production activation and DKIM rotation, existing mail-domain patterns outbound_dkim_signing.rs/outbound_reputation_throttle.rs/outbound_dlp_quarantine.rs and lib.rs exports, plus task82 evidence.

Owned scope only: worker-1 mail-domain worktree; crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/sending_domain_authentication.rs (or a more precise mail-domain-only filename if inspection demands), crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs wiring, evidence/fd001/cs-mail-sending-domain-authentication-domain-guard-fd001-alignment-*, evidence/multispectrum/cs-mail-sending-domain-authentication-domain-guard-fd001-alignment.json. Do not touch root manifests/Cargo.lock/contracts/registries/messenger/community/infra/adapters/live DNS/OpenBao/SMTP or worker-2/worker-3 evidence.

Claim OMX task + Oya VCS before writes. Implement pure-domain deterministic guard only: no DNS/network/crypto/adapters/async. It should return explicit allow/block/quarantine/review actions, reason constants, audit/ledger event labels, tenant/domain isolation fields using Classified<DataClass>, expiry/rotation/staleness checks, and non-empty tests covering allowed posture plus missing SPF, missing DMARC, none/p=none policy for prod, missing/expired DKIM selector, stale key rotation, tenant/domain mismatch, unverified domain, quarantine/review states, and audit label stability. Preserve clean architecture inward dependencies.

Verify fmt, focused sending-domain-authentication tests, full oya-connect-mail-domain tests, nextest for the package, clippy -D warnings, cargo metadata, planning-closure, data-class, architecture-boundaries, catalog validate, dependency-seam with multispectrum evidence, oya git diff --check, Oya VCS verify/done/promote, and commit. Report exact changed files, test counts, evidence paths, promotion status, not-tested gaps, and include a line starting exactly: Subagent skip reason: serialized worker-1 mail-domain outbound-authentication guard lane; active OMX team already parallelizes worker-2 messenger and worker-3 community work, and this pure domain guard is not safe to split further.
